statement: Fix a bulk lattice chart containing B2R(z), with all pins and all changes of ambient domain beyond a fixed proportional outer collar. For every α < 21/8, there are Cα < ∞ and uα > 0, depending on that fixed collar but not on the outer conditions, such that, for each fixed 0 < u < uα, lim sup δ↓0 P ( Acont 4 (z; uR, R) ) ≤ Cαuα . (2.8) This applies to the fixed diagonal resolution, and uniformly to complete resolutions. The same statement holds for circular annuli and for fixed-factor changes of the radii. In particular one may fix α > 2. The mesh limit precedes the limit u ↓ 0.
